name: S2-TOMG-Bench-mini
description:
S^2-Bench Dataset (TOMG) (mini version, 4.5k entries)
	

Official Huggingface Datasets for S^2-Bench: "Speak-to-Structure: Evaluating LLMs in Open-domain Natural Language-Driven Molecule Generation"
Please refer to our Github Repo for more usage and useful information.
This mini version offers a choice for researchers with limited resources.

	
		
	
	
		Configurations
	

Each configuration represents a different task:

MolCustom_AtomNum: Molecular customized generation by atom number… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/phenixace/S2-TOMG-Bench-mini.
evaluation_method: validity / Tanimoto similarity (also novelty and uniqueness commonly reported)
reputation: Emerging dataset for language-driven molecule generation with modest adoption in the computational chemistry and ML communities.
